summary: Peru’s restoration pledge is 30% of degraded ecosystems. Conservation calls for a 50% reduction in deforestation in the regions; by 2035, it also strengthens the capacities of fishers and aquaculturists in good productive, sanitary and environmental practices in at least 30% of the country’s regions. Agriculture has two 2035 goals: strengthen agricultural-system resilience in at least 87% of the country’s regions and increase livestock producers’ adaptive capacity in 100% of the country’s regions. The cross-sector LULUCF commitment reports a 54.0–69.9 MtCO₂eq target by 2035, with forest, protected-area, peatland, community and plantation measures. These are regional, degraded-area or emissions targets, not hectare targets. In 2022, forest covered 835,737 km² (64.3%), grassland 164,078 km² (12.6%), and agriculture 36,457 km² (2.8%); missing denominators prevent conversion into land shares, so 87% and 100% are regional rather than agricultural-area coverage.
